name: variant-fm-benchmark
description: Ranking is saturated, calibration is not, and neither changes the evidence strength — code and frozen analysis set Software and frozen data underlying the manuscript "Ranking is saturated, calibration is not, and neither changes the evidence strength: an independent benchmark of splice-region variant effect predictors against a functional standard" (N. Zhang). WHAT CHANGED IN THIS VERSIONThis release adopts frozen-matrix-v2 as the analysis set. The SpliceAI, Pangolin and Nucleotide Transformer columns of the published frozen-matrix-v1 are replaced by the output of pinned scorers — Pangolin at git commit 5cf94b8 and SpliceAI at full floating-point precision, both reproducing the v1 columns exactly when re-rounded to the printed precision; Nucleotide Transformer re-scored under a pinned environment (rank correlation with the original column ρ = 0.9997) — and nothing else in the matrix is changed. The external TP53 validation now uses all ten predictors. Positive likelihood ratios are reported on two bases: at the scanned observed threshold and interpolated to exactly 95% specificity. The v1 result tables are retained beside the v2 tables, with a listing of every quantity that moved between them.
